draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 90th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 16th of 36 at WR. He lasted until pick 115, well after his grade rank (90th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Allen Lazard. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 830 receiving yards in 2025, 17th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
